name: comment-item
title: Comment item
description: One comment with author, role, time, an edited note and a body that folds, with reply, edit and delete. Nest replies to compose a thread.
docs: Pass author ({ name, image, href }), createdAt, body and, for a role next to the name, badge. editedAt adds an Edited note beside the time. actions lists what this viewer may do: reply is a button under the body, and edit and delete appear in an overflow menu, so give them only on the viewer's own comments. onAction receives the action; a delete runs it only after the person confirms in the comment itself (focus goes to Keep it, Escape cancels), and if it returns a promise the button waits, and if the promise rejects the comment says so and stays. Bodies of more than six lines fold behind Show more, a button that only exists when there is something to unfold; a plain string keeps its line breaks. For editing, set editing and put your own editor in body: it is shown in full and the actions step aside, and when editing ends focus goes back to the menu button. highlighted frames the comment a permalink points at and sets aria-current; give it an id so the link can find it. Replies are children: pass more CommentItems with size="sm" and they nest along a thread line. footer sits next to Reply, for a reaction bar. Without now, times start as a date and clock time and turn relative once the page is live.
